description: Defines a template class PingPongEnabled for WebSocket ping-pong handling, including methods for starting ping, scheduling, handling pong responses, and connection state management.

classes.name: PingPongEnabled
classes.description: A template class providing WebSocket ping-pong functionality with start, schedule, and callback handling.

methods.name: startPing
methods.description: Initializes ping process by setting pong handlers and scheduling the first ping.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Sets a timer to call a callback after a specified interval.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message if the connection is open.

methods.name: onPong
methods.description: Handles receipt of a pong message and schedules the next ping.

methods.name: onPongTimeout
methods.description: Handles pong timeout by closing the connection.
